name: Michiru Hoshikawa
source:
Michiru is a bright and bubbly girl who cares deeply about her friends and would do anything for them. She lives alone in her father's apartment as he is away for work. She loves strawberry shortcake.

[from [url=https://honeysweetlies.carrd.co/#characters]official website[/url]]
